description: This file contains a static utility class 'DoubleUtil' providing floating-point comparison methods, including approximate equality checks for doubles, points, rectangles, sizes, vectors, and NaN checks, used internally within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: DoubleUtil
classes.description: A static class providing floating-point comparison utilities, including methods for approximate equality, NaN detection, and conversions relevant to PDFsharp's internal calculations.

methods.name: AreClose
methods.description: Checks if two double values are approximately equal within a small epsilon margin.

methods.name: AreRoughlyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two double values are approximately equal within a specified decimal place precision.

methods.name: AreClose
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if two XPoint structures are approximately equal.

methods.name: AreClose
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if two XRect structures are approximately equal.

methods.name: AreClose
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if two XSize structures are approximately equal.

methods.name: AreClose
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if two XVector structures are approximately equal.

methods.name: GreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if one double is greater than another and not approximately equal.

methods.name: GreaterThanOrClose
methods.description: Checks if one double is greater than or approximately equal to another.

methods.name: LessThan
methods.description: Checks if one double is less than another and not approximately equal.

methods.name: LessThanOrClose
methods.description: Checks if one double is less than or approximately equal to another.

methods.name: IsBetweenZeroAndOne
methods.description: Checks if a double value is between 0 and 1, inclusive, considering approximate equality.

methods.name: IsNaN
methods.description: Checks if a double value is Not-a-Number (NaN).

methods.name: RectHasNaN
methods.description: Checks if any component of an XRect is NaN.

methods.name: IsOne
methods.description: Checks if a double value is approximately 1.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if a double value is approximately 0.

methods.name: DoubleToInt
methods.description: Converts a double to an integer with rounding.
